Can anyone share the question format of future first of this year

Hey guys! I found a few recent Futures First OA experiences from 2026. The pattern seems to vary depending on the role, but for Market Analyst/Financial Markets roles, the OA mainly focuses on aptitude, speed maths, logical reasoning, and data interpretation.

One candidate reported 45 aptitude and reasoning questions in 27 minutes, followed by 15 rapid-calculation questions in just 3 minutes. Another recent experience mentioned 30 MCQs, with a strong emphasis on mental maths and analytical reasoning.

For preparation, focus on percentages, ratios, averages, probability, permutations and combinations, number series, puzzles, graphs, data interpretation, and quick multiplication/division. Speed and accuracy seem to be very important.

The next rounds may include a group assessment or game round, followed by interviews covering logical puzzles, probability, mental maths, financial markets, derivatives, and HR questions. The process differs by role, so Quant/Algo positions may also have coding or DSA questions.

If anyone appeared for the latest Futures First OA, especially for the 2026 campus drive, please share the exact pattern, questions, time limits, and subsequent rounds. It would be really helpful for everyone preparing!
